title: Running one Vitest file in a repository whose test script wraps every project

commands.reason: vitest refuses to run outside its runner; the top frame is a chunk of the vendored vitest dist, so the key is stable
the trap's tail is a totals row with nothing specific left in its block, so the product's failure arm derives no sig_v1
